```{r}
analysis_df_pheno <- analysis_df_pheno %>% mutate(baseline_first_ckd_60 = ifelse(egfr < 60, 1,0))
```

# 1. Identify all baseline phenotype columns to be tested

```{r}
baseline_phenos <- colnames(analysis_df_pheno) %>%
  grep("^baseline_first", ., value = TRUE)

phewas_results <- map_dfr(baseline_phenos, function(pheno_name) {
  
  if (sum(analysis_df_pheno[[pheno_name]], na.rm = TRUE) < 20) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  formula <- as.formula(paste0("`", pheno_name, "` ~ Factor2_score_z + Age.at.recruitment + Sex + Body.mass.index..BMI....Instance.0.participant...p21001_i0. + smoking_status_current_previous + on_ras_inhibitor"))
  
  model <- tryCatch({
    glm(formula, data = analysis_df_pheno, family = "binomial")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Could not fit model for: ", pheno_name)
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)
  
  tidy(model) %>%
    filter(term == "Factor2_score_z") %>%
    mutate(phenotype = pheno_name) # Add phenotype name for tracking
})

knitr::kable(head(phewas_results, n=50), caption = "PheWAS Results Summary Table")
```

```{r}
# Process the results for plotting
phewas_plot_data <- phewas_results %>%
  mutate(
    OR = exp(estimate),
    log2_OR = log2(OR),
    neg_log10_p = -log10(p.value),
    clean_pheno = case_when(
      phenotype == "baseline_first_ckd_60" ~ "CKD (eGFR < 60)",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_ckd" ~ "CKD (ICD-based)",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_glomerular" ~ "Glomerular Dz.",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_tubulointerstitial" ~ "Tubulointerstitial Dz.",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_htn" ~ "Hypertension",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_dm_all" ~ "Diabetes",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_hfcm" ~ "Heart Failure",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_mi" ~ "Myocardial Infarction",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_ischd" ~ "Ischemic Heart Dz.",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_atherosclerosis" ~ "Atherosclerosis",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_pvd" ~ "Peripheral Vasc. Dz.",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_afib" ~ "Atrial Fibrillation",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_stroke" ~ "Stroke",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_hypothyroid" ~ "Hypothyroidism",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_hyperthyroid" ~ "Hyperthyroidism",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_obesity" ~ "Obesity",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_lipidaemia" ~ "Dyslipidemia",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_copd" ~ "COPD",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_asthma" ~ "Asthma",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_ild" ~ "Interstitial Lung Dz.",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_ibd" ~ "IBD",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_liver_disease" ~ "Liver Disease",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_ra" ~ "Rheumatoid Arthritis",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_gout" ~ "Gout",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_oa_knee" ~ "Osteoarthritis (Knee)",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_lupus" ~ "Lupus",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_osteoporosis" ~ "Osteoporosis",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_bph" ~ "BPH",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_parkinsons" ~ "Parkinson's Dz.",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_alzheimers" ~ "Alzheimer's Dz.",
      phenotype == "baseline_first_other_neurodegenerative" ~ "Other Neurodeg. Dz.",
      TRUE ~ gsub("baseline_first_", "", phenotype) # Fallback for any missed names
    ),
    category = case_when(
      grepl("CKD|AKI|Glomerular|Tubulointerstitial", clean_pheno) ~ "Renal",
      grepl("Hypertension|Heart Failure|Myocardial Infarction|Ischemic|Atherosclerosis|Peripheral|Atrial|Stroke", clean_pheno) ~ "Cardiometabolic",
      grepl("Diabetes|Hypothyroidism|Hyperthyroidism|Obesity|Dyslipidemia|Gout", clean_pheno) ~ "Endocrine/Metabolic",
      grepl("COPD|Asthma|Interstitial", clean_pheno) ~ "Respiratory",
      grepl("Liver|IBD", clean_pheno) ~ "Digestive",
      grepl("Rheumatoid|Osteoarthritis|Lupus|Osteoporosis", clean_pheno) ~ "Musculoskeletal",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    category = factor(category, levels = c("Cardiometabolic", "Endocrine/Metabolic", "Respiratory", "Digestive", "Musculoskeletal", "Other", "Renal"))
  )

# Define significance threshold (Bonferroni correction)
bonferroni_threshold <- 0.05 / nrow(phewas_plot_data)

# Create the Volcano Plot
phewas_volcano_plot <- ggplot(phewas_plot_data, aes(x = log2_OR, y = neg_log10_p)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = category, size = 2), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(phewas_plot_data, p.value < bonferroni_threshold | category == 'Renal'),
    aes(label = clean_pheno),
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = 15,
    box.padding = 0.5,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = 'grey50',
    fontface = 'bold'
  ) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(bonferroni_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +

  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "black") +

  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 4)) +
  labs(
    title = "Factor 2 Score Association with Baseline Phenotypes",
    subtitle = "Fully adjusted model (Age, Sex, BMI, Smoking, RAAS inhibitors use)",
    x = "Log2(Odds Ratio) per SD increase in Factor 2 Score",
    y = "-log10(P-value)",
    color = "Phenotype Category"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  guides(size = "none") # Hide the size legend

# Print the plot
print(phewas_volcano_plot)
```

```{r}
pdf("phewas_volcano_plot.pdf", width = 12, height = 8)
print(phewas_volcano_plot)
dev.off()
```
